stem.text: The distribution of molecular energies in an ideal gas can be represented in a Boltzmann distribution.
Which change in conditions leads to a **larger** value for the number of molecules that have the most probable energy?

A.text: keeping the temperature constant but decreasing the pressure

B.text: keeping the pressure constant but decreasing the temperature

C.text: keeping the temperature constant but increasing the pressure

D.text: keeping the pressure constant but increasing the temperature
